source: Wikidata (CC0), P625 for the names match-via-wikipedia.py identified as administrative units rather than settlements
note: Names FamilySearch files books under that are provinces, counties and comarques rather than towns. They are drawn as AREAS — through division_label, so the dot says «(area)» — because a book filed to a county must not look like a book filed to a parish. The coordinate was already fetched when these were identified and was not being written down; this file is that omission fixed. Every point is checked against geo.country_of() and filed where the ground is, so a county of the Kingdom of Hungary whose ground is Slovak today is Slovak here.

areas.name: County Cork
areas.why: Wikidata lists 'Cork' as an alias of County Cork and two of three paths are explicitly at [County] level (Tithe Applotment Books, 1841 census; parish Aghadown is in County Cork); the newspaper path 'Ireland > Cork > Cork' has the county then the city as town, so city-of-Cork books in that collection would also fall here.

areas.name: Saint-François judicial district (seat Sherbrooke)
areas.is: judicial district of Quebec; point is its seat Sherbrooke, the district has no coordinate of its own
areas.why: The Wikipedia table of Quebec judicial districts lists a Saint-François district with its seat at Sherbrooke, and the top path level here is tagged [Judicial District] in a Quebec notarial collection; the Catholic-register path 'Saint-François > Saint-François' is the parish level inside it.

areas.name: Annapolis County
areas.why: Filed under CA at [County] level in two Nova Scotia collections (probate, deaths) and the parish path runs through Granville Centre, which is in Annapolis County; one collection (Freedmen's Bureau) is Annapolis, Maryland, which does not belong to this point.

areas.name: Moga district
areas.why: Wikipedia/Wikidata give Moga district in Punjab (created 1995), and the only collection is 'India, Punjab, Moga Land Ownership Pedigrees', so the district office is that district's.

areas.name: Southern Registry of Deeds district, Aroostook County (seat Houlton)
areas.is: registry of deeds district of Aroostook County, Maine; point is its seat Houlton, the district has no coordinate of its own
areas.why: Aroostook County's own site says the Southern Registry of Deeds is at 26 Court Street, Houlton, and serves the southern towns of the county (Houlton, Presque Isle, Caribou and others), matching the Maine Aroostook County deed-book collection.

areas.name: Montmagny judicial district (seat Montmagny)
areas.is: judicial district of Quebec; point is its seat Montmagny, the district has no coordinate of its own
areas.why: The Wikipedia table of Quebec judicial districts lists Montmagny with its seat at Montmagny; the path is tagged [Judicial District] in the Quebec notarial collection, and the parish Saint-Thomas (de Montmagny) is inside it.

areas.name: Launceston and country districts registration area, Tasmania (centred on Launceston)
areas.is: civil registration district of Tasmania; point is the city of Launceston, the district has no coordinate of its own
areas.why: Tasmanian Archives series such as RGD35 are titled 'Register of Deaths in Launceston & Country Districts', i.e. the northern registration area around Launceston, matching the Tasmania civil registration collection.

areas.name: Alabama
areas.why: The name is Alabama with a stray byte-order mark in front; the path level is [State] in the WWI draft cards collection.

areas.name: Roberval judicial district (seat Roberval)
areas.is: judicial district of Quebec; point is its seat Roberval, the district has no coordinate of its own
areas.why: The Wikipedia table of Quebec judicial districts lists Roberval with its seat at Roberval; the path is tagged [Judicial District] in the Quebec notarial collection and the parish Notre-Dame-du-Lac-Saint-Jean is in the Lac-Saint-Jean region it serves.

areas.name: LeFlore County, Oklahoma
areas.why: Wikidata lists 'Le Flore County, Oklahoma' as an alias, and both collections (Oklahoma probate, school records) are Oklahoma; the path is at [County] level.

areas.name: Szabolcs County (Szabolcs vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: English Wikipedia describes Szabolcs as a historic county of the Kingdom of Hungary with capital Nyíregyháza; the path's registration districts (Nyiregyháza, Polgár, Újfehértó) are in that county.

areas.name: Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok County (former)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia's former county (1876-1950, capital Szolnok, districts incl. Jászberény and Mezőtúr) matches the path's Szolnok, Jászberény and Mezőtúr; the name differs only by the hyphen in Nagy-Kun (typography, not a spelling).

areas.name: Pest-Pilis-Solt-Kiskun County
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county 1876-1950 with capital Budapest (Hungarian: Pest-Pilis-Solt-Kiskun vármegye); the path's Budapest districts agree; 'Kis-Kun' vs 'Kiskun' is only hyphenation.

areas.name: Borsod County (Borsod vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county of the Kingdom of Hungary, capital Miskolc; path districts Miskolcz and Mezőkövesd are in it (the Apátfalva sub-path was not checked).

areas.name: Hajdú County (Hajdú vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county (1876-1950), capital Debrecen; the path's Debreczen, Hajduböszörmény and Hajduszoboszló are its towns; 'Hajdu' is the unaccented spelling of Hajdú (Wikidata alias 'Hajdu County').

areas.name: Bihar County (Bihar vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county, capital Nagyvárad (Oradea); after 1920 a Hungarian rump county (capital Berettyóújfalu) remained, which is where Derecske, Komádi, Nagyléta lie. Wikidata point is the whole county's centre in Romania; the Hungarian-registration books sit in the western part. Collection 'India, Hindu Pilgrimage Records' is an unrelated mis-filing.

areas.name: Komárom County (Komárom vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county astride the Danube (Hungary south, Slovakia north); Tata and Ószőny (Hungary) and the 1869 Slovakia census both agree. The Wikidata point sits at Komárom/Komárno; OSM reverse geocoding places it in Slovakia, but it is on the border. (Point lies on the Danube border; the outline test places it in HU, which is also where the Hungarian county seat books are filed.)

areas.name: Bács-Bodrog County
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: county of the Kingdom of Hungary, capital Zombor (Sombor), with a northern rump around Baja kept by Hungary after 1920; path Baja agrees. Point is Wikidata's, in Serbia.

areas.name: Sáros County (Sáros vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county, capital Eperjes (Prešov), now north-east Slovakia; the 'Slovakia, Census, 1869' collection agrees.

areas.name: Csanád County (Csanád vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county, capital Makó from 1730, mostly in Hungary; the path's Makó, Battonya and Mezőhegyes are its places.

areas.name: Szepes County (Szepes vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county (German Zips, Slovak Spiš), now mostly north-east Slovakia with a sliver in Poland; the 'Slovakia, Census, 1869' collection agrees.

areas.name: Bars County (Bars vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county, now central/southern Slovakia (Tekov), agreeing with the 'Slovakia, Census, 1869' collection; caveat: the sub-path 'Bars > Dunafalva' in the Hungary civil registration points to Dunafalva in Bács-Kiskun, which is not in Bars, so that filing looks like an FS error.

areas.name: Szatmár County (Szatmár vármegye)
areas.is: county of the Kingdom of Hungary
areas.why: Wikipedia: historic county, capital Nagykároly (Carei), now mostly Romania with a Hungarian part around Nábrád, Fehérgyarmat and Mátészalka (the path's districts); Wikidata point is in Romania.

areas.name: Tver Governorate
areas.why: Wikidata/Wikipedia Tver Governorate (ru label Тверская губерния); the Province-level path Тверь > Осташков/Кашин/Тверь (уезд) lists uezds of that governorate and the collections are titled Russia, Tver.

areas.name: Bessarabia Governorate
areas.why: Wikidata item (ru alias Бессарабская область also listed) is the Russian-Empire province whose districts include Кишинев and Оргеев, as in the path; the point given by Wikidata is in Chisinau (Moldova); parts of the old province now lie in Ukraine.

areas.name: Tula Governorate
areas.why: Province-level path Тула > Ефремов/Белев/Тула matches the uezds of Tula Governorate, and the collection is Russia, Tula.

areas.name: Kazan Governorate
areas.why: Province,District path Казань > Казань/Лаишев with Tatarstan collections is the Kazan Governorate (not just the city); Wikidata point is that item's own P625.

areas.name: Yekaterinoslav Governorate
areas.why: Path Екатеринослав > Александровск/Бахмут (Юзовка, Мариуполь) lists uezds of Yekaterinoslav Governorate; collections are Ukraine (Donetsk, Zaporizhia); the governorate seat/point is Dnipro, Ukraine, though FamilySearch files it under RU.

areas.name: Archdiocese of Uppsala (Uppsala stift)
areas.is: diocese of the Church of Sweden (jurisdiction of the Uppsala cathedral chapter)
areas.why: Swedish Wikipedia says a domkapitel is the governing body of a stift and is named after its diocese; Wikidata lists 'Uppsala stift' as an alias of Q877677 with its own P625, and the collection is 'Sweden, Uppsala, Church Records'. The name is the chapter (an institution), so it is drawn as its diocese area.

areas.name: Diocese of Lund (Lunds stift)
areas.is: diocese of the Church of Sweden (jurisdiction of the Lund cathedral chapter)
areas.why: A domkapitel is the body of the stift named after it (sv.wikipedia); the English Wikipedia infobox gives the Diocese of Lund (Blekinge and Skane) the point 55.70417, 13.19361 (Lund Cathedral), and the collection is 'Sweden, Malmohus, Church Records'. Wikidata holds that point only as a qualifier on the seat statement.

areas.name: Wymbritseradiel (Wymbritseradeel)
areas.why: Wikidata Q850682 (Wymbritseradiel) lists 'Wymbritseradeel' as an English alias and English Wikipedia says that spelling is used for the old municipality; the paths sit under Friesland, and the point is Wikidata's own P625 (the pre-1984 item Q1901963 has no coordinate).

areas.name: Diocese of Stockholm (Stockholms stift)
areas.is: diocese of the Church of Sweden (jurisdiction of the Stockholm cathedral chapter)
areas.why: A domkapitel is the governing body of the stift named after it (sv.wikipedia); the English Wikipedia infobox for the Church of Sweden's Diocese of Stockholm (seat Storkyrkan) gives 59.32583, 18.07056, and the collection is 'Sweden, Stockholm, Church Records'.

areas.name: Diocese of Strängnäs (Strängnäs stift)
areas.is: diocese of the Church of Sweden (jurisdiction of the Strängnäs cathedral chapter)
areas.why: A domkapitel is the body of the stift named after it (sv.wikipedia); Wikidata Q876816 carries 'Strängnäs stift' as alias with its own P625, and the two collections (Orebro, Sodermanland) lie within the historic Strängnäs diocese.

areas.why: Wikidata and English Wikipedia name the Friesland municipality 'Kollumerland en Nieuwkruisland' (the filing differs only by a space in Nieuw Kruisland, a typographic difference), matching the Friesland civil registration collection; the point is Wikidata's P625 (the Wikipedia infobox gives a nearby 53.283, 6.133).
